description: This file contains the `ChatMarkdownPreprocessor` enum which provides static functions for preprocessing markdown text in chat messages. It handles tasks such as stripping headers, context blocks, message IDs, images, and timestamps, and normalizing the markdown content. It also defines some internal data structures like `InlineImage` and `Result` for processing images and results.

classes.name: InlineImage
classes.description: A struct representing an inline image with a label and an optional image data.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: A struct representing the result of markdown preprocessing, including cleaned text and extracted images.

methods.name: preprocess
methods.description: Public static method that preprocesses the input markdown string by removing envelope info, message ID hints, context blocks, timestamps, and extracting images, returning a cleaned result.

methods.name: inlineImage
methods.description: Private static method that creates an InlineImage from a label and source string if source contains base64 encoded image data.

methods.name: fallbackImageLabel
methods.description: Private static method that returns a sanitized fallback label for images.

methods.name: stripEnvelope
methods.description: Removes envelope headers from the raw markdown if they look like envelope headers.

methods.name: looksLikeEnvelopeHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header string resembles an envelope header based on date patterns or known channel prefixes.

methods.name: stripMessageIdHints
methods.description: Removes message ID hint lines from the markdown text.

methods.name: stripInboundContextBlocks
methods.description: Removes inbound context blocks, including untrusted context, from the markdown.

methods.name: shouldStripTrailingUntrustedContext
methods.description: Determines if untrusted context blocks should be stripped based on specific regex patterns.

methods.name: stripPrefixedTimestamps
methods.description: Removes prefixed timestamps from the markdown text.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes the markdown text by replacing newlines and trimming whitespace.
